_note: Chapter 15 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The market offers an abundant supply of second-hand books at low prices.
ex.cn: 市场上旧书供应充足，价格也很低。
ex.note: be abundant in 富含；an abundant supply of 大量供应

ex.en: Finishing the project was the greatest achievement of his first year.
ex.cn: 完成这个项目是他大学第一年最大的成就。
ex.note: a sense of achievement 成就感；achieve sth. 取得某项成就

ex.en: The team decided to adopt an open-source tool instead of building one from scratch.
ex.cn: 团队决定采用一款开源工具，而不是从头开发。
ex.note: adopt a plan 采纳计划；adopt a child 收养孩子

ex.en: The three of them signed a simple agreement before the term began.
ex.cn: 开学前，他们三个人签了一份简单的协议。
ex.note: reach an agreement 达成协议；in agreement with 与…一致

ex.en: Her explanation was altogether unconvincing, and nobody in the room said a word.
ex.cn: 她的解释完全站不住脚，屋里没有一个人说话。
ex.note: altogether = in total 总共；altogether too 太、过于

ex.en: The noise from the building next door began to annoy him.
ex.cn: 隔壁楼传来的声音开始让他心烦。
ex.note: be annoyed with sb. 为某人生气；annoy sb. 打扰某人

ex.en: Most of these rules were written for offices and are hardly applicable to a school club.
ex.cn: 这些规则大多是为办公室写的，几乎不适用于学校社团。
ex.note: be applicable to 适用于；applicable to sb./sth. 对某人/某事适用

ex.en: The parcel finally arrived two weeks after he had ordered it.
ex.cn: 包裹在他下单两个星期之后才终于送到。
ex.note: arrive at/in 到达；arrive at a decision 得出结论

ex.en: The wall was covered with posters of astronauts and rockets.
ex.cn: 墙上贴满了宇航员和火箭的海报。

ex.en: The average price of a used textbook here is about thirty yuan.
ex.cn: 这里一本二手教材的平均价格大约是三十元。
ex.note: on average 平均而言

ex.en: We spent an average of four hours a day in the library.
ex.cn: 我们平均每天在图书馆待四个小时。

ex.en: The weather here averages about twenty degrees in October.
ex.cn: 这里十月份的气温平均在二十摄氏度左右。
ex.note: average out 算出平均值

ex.en: They sat on the bank of the river and watched the boats go by.
ex.cn: 他们坐在河岸上，看着小船驶过。
ex.note: the bank of a river 河岸；a blood bank 血库；go to the bank 去银行

ex.en: The coffee was made from dark beans roasted in the old town.
ex.cn: 咖啡是用老城里烘焙的深色豆子做的。
ex.note: coffee beans 咖啡豆；green beans 青豆

ex.en: He tightened his belt and walked home without any lunch.
ex.cn: 他勒紧腰带，没吃午饭就往家走。
ex.note: tighten one's belt 勒紧腰带（省吃俭用）；a belt of grassland 草地地带

ex.en: Clouds gathered over the square, and the sudden rain turned the stones black.
ex.cn: 广场上空聚起乌云，那场急雨把石板地打得发黑。
ex.note: in black 穿着黑衣；black and white 黑白分明

ex.en: She sold more than a hundred books in her very first term.
ex.cn: 她第一个学期就卖掉了一百多本书。
ex.note: a book of poems 一本诗集；by the book 按规则地

ex.en: We booked a table for four at the restaurant near the north gate.
ex.cn: 我们在北门附近那家餐馆订了一张四人桌。
ex.note: book a ticket/room 订票/订房间

ex.en: She held the notebook against her breast as she read.
ex.cn: 她一边读，一边把笔记本抱在胸前。
ex.note: against one's breast 贴在胸前

ex.en: The weather bureau issued a warning about the storm that was coming.
ex.cn: 气象局发布了大风暴即将来临的预警。
ex.note: bureau of statistics 统计局；a travel bureau 旅行社

ex.en: He took a picture of the sign with his phone camera.
ex.cn: 他用手机相机拍下了那块牌子。
ex.note: a security camera 监控摄像头；in camera 秘密地

ex.en: Please carry this heavy box up to the fourth floor for me.
ex.cn: 帮我把这个重箱子搬到四楼去。
ex.note: carry on 继续；carry out 执行；carry off 获得

ex.en: Their office is in the central part of the city, close to the main library.
ex.cn: 他们的办公室在市中心，紧挨着主图书馆。
ex.note: central to sth. 对某事至关重要；central station 中央车站

ex.en: The crowd cheered when the first plane landed safely.
ex.cn: 第一架飞机安全着陆时，人群欢呼起来。
ex.note: cheer sb. on 为某人加油

ex.en: A cheer of welcome rose from the students as the team entered.
ex.cn: 队伍一进场，学生们便发出一阵欢迎的欢呼。
ex.note: a cheer for sb. 为某人欢呼；with a cheer 高呼一声

ex.en: A circle of children gathered around the puppet show.
ex.cn: 一群孩子围着木偶表演站成一圈。
ex.note: in circles 绕圈子；a circle of friends 一群朋友

ex.en: Birds circled above the field before they finally landed.
ex.cn: 鸟儿在田地上空盘旋，之后才落下。
ex.note: circle around 绕着…转

ex.en: They climbed four flights of stairs to reach the top floor.
ex.cn: 他们爬了四层楼梯才到顶楼。
ex.note: climb up 爬上；climb into 钻进

ex.en: The two cars were involved in a collision near the junction.
ex.cn: 两辆车在路口附近撞在了一起。
ex.note: a collision between A and B A与B的碰撞；come into collision with 与…相撞

ex.en: The report gives a comparative study of prices in four cities.
ex.cn: 这份报告对四个城市的价格做了比较研究。
ex.note: comparative advantage 比较优势；the comparative degree 比较级

ex.en: The whole concept is simple: list a book, give it a price, and let others find it.
ex.cn: 整个想法很简单：把书列出来，标个价钱，让别人自己找。
ex.note: the concept of … …的概念；conceptualize 将…概念化

ex.en: She was conscious of being watched by the man across the street.
ex.cn: 她意识到街对面的那个男人正在看她。
ex.note: be conscious of 意识到；consciousness 意识

ex.en: The continual noise from the construction site made studying impossible.
ex.cn: 工地持续不断的噪音让人没法学习。
ex.note: continual vs. continuous 不断的 vs. 连续的

ex.en: They left the boxes in the corner of the classroom.
ex.cn: 他们把箱子放在教室的角落里。
ex.note: in a tight corner 陷入困境；from every corner 从各处

ex.en: The story received wide coverage in the local newspapers.
ex.cn: 这件事在本地报纸上得到了广泛报道。
ex.note: media coverage 媒体报道；insurance coverage 保险范围

ex.en: The first version of the machine was crude, but it did the job.
ex.cn: 机器的第一个版本很粗糙，但还真管用。
ex.note: crude oil 原油；a crude estimate 粗略估计

ex.en: He cannot eat dairy, so he drinks almond milk instead.
ex.cn: 他不能吃乳制品，所以改喝杏仁奶。
ex.note: dairy products 乳制品；a dairy farm 奶牛场

ex.en: The advertisement deceived many people into thinking the bag was made of leather.
ex.cn: 这则广告骗得许多人以为这个包是皮革做的。
ex.note: deceive sb. into doing sth. 骗某人做某事

ex.en: The cake at the little restaurant near the gate was delicious.
ex.cn: 那家小饭馆里的蛋糕很美味。
ex.note: deliciously 美味地

ex.en: He put his notebook on the desk and started to write.
ex.cn: 他把笔记本摊在书桌上，动手写起来。
ex.note: a reception desk 前台；desk job 案头工作

ex.en: Many small shops died when the new supermarket opened.
ex.cn: 新超市开张后，许多小店倒闭了。
ex.note: die out 绝迹；die of 死于；die for 为…而死

ex.en: The textbook came with a disc containing the recorded lecture.
ex.cn: 这本教材附了一张光盘，里面是讲座的录像。
ex.note: a compact disc 光盘；hard disc 硬盘

ex.en: The old shops in this district closed one by one over the years.
ex.cn: 这些年，这个街区的老店一家接一家地关掉了。
ex.note: in the … district 在…区；a business district 商业区

ex.en: He looked doubtful, but he agreed to give it a try.
ex.cn: 他看起来将信将疑，但还是答应试一试。
ex.note: doubtful of/about 对…怀疑；be doubtful whether … 怀疑是否…

ex.en: Her voice was flat and dry, with no warmth in it at all.
ex.cn: 她的声音平板而干涩，没有一点温度。
ex.note: dry season 旱季；a dry sense of humour 冷幽默

ex.en: Hang the wet clothes outside so that they can dry.
ex.cn: 把湿衣服晾到外面去，这样它们才能干。
ex.note: dry out 弄干；dry off（衣服）晾干

ex.en: The new library was designed to fit into the ecology of the old town.
ex.cn: 新图书馆的设计，是为了融入老城的生态。
ex.note: ecological balance 生态平衡；the ecology of … …的生态

ex.en: The electric kettle began to hiss as the storm broke outside.
ex.cn: 外面暴风雨来临时，电水壶开始嘶嘶作响。
ex.note: electric power 电力；an electric atmosphere 令人激动的气氛

ex.en: The scheme could create employment for students in the town.
ex.cn: 这个计划可以为镇上的学生创造就业机会。
ex.note: employment opportunities 就业机会；take employment 就业

ex.en: Winning the competition entitled them to a small office on campus.
ex.cn: 赢得比赛让他们有权使用校园里的一间小办公室。
ex.note: be entitled to sth. 有权享有某物；entitle sb. to call sb. sth. 使某人有权称呼某人为某头衔

ex.en: Have you ever thought of turning your old notes into a small business?
ex.cn: 你有没有想过把你旧的笔记做成一门小生意？
ex.note: ever since 自从；hardly ever 几乎从不；疑问句中表示“曾经”

ex.en: The report is exclusive to this newspaper and may not be reprinted.
ex.cn: 这份报道是该报独有的，不得转载。
ex.note: exclusive rights 独家权利；exclusive of 不包括；an exclusive contract 排他性合同

ex.en: The new railway line is simply an extension of the old one.
ex.cn: 新铁路线不过是原线路的延伸。
ex.note: an extension of … …的延伸；by extension 通过延伸；a telephone extension 分机

ex.en: He visited his family every winter holiday.
ex.cn: 每个寒假他都回家看家人。
ex.note: a family of six 六口之家；one of the family 家庭成员

ex.en: The plan is technically feasible, but it will take far more time than we thought.
ex.cn: 这个方案在技术上可行，但花的时间会比我们预想的多得多。
ex.note: a feasible plan 可行的计划；feasible for 对…可行

ex.en: Please fill the glass with cold tea before the meeting starts.
ex.cn: 开会之前，请把杯子倒满凉茶。
ex.note: fill out 填写；fill in 填上；be filled with 充满

ex.en: His flight from Beijing was delayed by two hours.
ex.cn: 他从北京飞来的航班延误了两个小时。
ex.note: a flight of stairs 一段楼梯；a direct flight 直飞航班

ex.en: A line of sweat ran across his forehead as he stood at the door.
ex.cn: 他站在门口时，额头上淌过一道汗。
ex.note: sweat on one's forehead 额头出汗

ex.en: The report proposes a new framework for judging student projects.
ex.cn: 这份报告提出了评判学生项目的新框架。
ex.note: within the framework of 在…框架之内；a legal framework 法律框架

ex.en: A large crowd came to the funeral of the old fisherman.
ex.cn: 老渔民的葬礼上来了很多人。
ex.note: attend a funeral 参加葬礼；funeral services 葬礼仪式

ex.en: The new system can generate a list of similar books in a second.
ex.cn: 新系统一秒钟就能生成一份相似书籍的清单。
ex.note: generate income 创造收入；generate electricity 发电

ex.en: My goal this year is to finish two novels.
ex.cn: 我今年的目标是写完两本小说。
ex.note: set a goal 设定目标；a goal in football 进球

ex.en: A bunch of grapes makes a cheap and healthy snack for students.
ex.cn: 一串葡萄对学生来说是既便宜又健康的零食。
ex.note: grape juice 葡萄汁；wine grapes 酿酒葡萄

ex.en: The guide book lists the best small restaurants in the city.
ex.cn: 这本指南列出了城里最好的几家小餐馆。
ex.note: a tourist guide 导游；a guide to … …的指南

ex.en: She guided him through the application form step by step.
ex.cn: 她一步步地带着他把申请表填完。
ex.note: guide sb. through sth. 引导某人做完某事

ex.en: There was hardly any wind on the river that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上河上几乎没有风。
ex.note: hardly ever 几乎从不；hardly more than 仅仅

ex.en: The library was not heaven, but it was quiet and warm.
ex.cn: 图书馆算不上天堂，但安静又暖和。
ex.note: in seventh heaven 欣喜若狂

ex.en: He blamed himself for the failure of the first show.
ex.cn: 他把首场演出的失败归咎于自己。
ex.note: by himself 独自；help himself to 随便吃

ex.en: The old machine made a horrible noise every time it started.
ex.cn: 那台旧机器每次一启动，就发出难听的声音。
ex.note: a horrible noise 难听的声音；horrible weather 糟糕的天气

ex.en: Buses that run on hydrogen may soon appear in big cities.
ex.cn: 以氢为燃料的公交车也许很快就会出现在大城市里。
ex.note: hydrogen fuel 氢燃料；green hydrogen 绿氢

ex.en: Small decisions made early on can have a huge impact on a young company.
ex.cn: 早期做出的微小决定，可能对一家年轻公司产生巨大影响。
ex.note: have an impact on 对…有影响

ex.en: The new rule may impact every student who uses the library.
ex.cn: 新规定可能会影响每一个使用图书馆的学生。
ex.note: impact on 对…产生影响

ex.en: The sign indicates that the road is closed for repairs.
ex.cn: 牌子表明这条路正在维修，暂停通行。
ex.note: indicate that … 表明；a sign indicating the way 指路的标志

ex.en: It was an innocent mistake, and the manager accepted the apology.
ex.cn: 那不过是个无心的误会，经理接受了道歉。
ex.note: be innocent of 没有…的罪责；an innocent mistake 无心的过错

ex.en: She spoke with such intensity that the whole room fell silent.
ex.cn: 她说话时那股强烈的气势，让整个房间都静了下来。
ex.note: with intensity 强烈地；the intensity of light 光强

ex.en: She kept her feelings inward and said nothing to anyone.
ex.cn: 她把情绪藏在心里，什么也没对别人说。
ex.note: turn inward 转向内心；inward thoughts 内心的想法

ex.en: The judge asked the team to explain how they would keep the site safe.
ex.cn: 评委要求这个团队解释他们打算如何保证网站安全。
ex.note: a judge 判断者；as a judge 作为裁判

ex.en: Do not judge a book by its cover.
ex.cn: 不要凭封面来判断一本书的好坏。
ex.note: judge by 从…来判断；judge sb. for sth. 因某事评价某人

ex.en: A kite flew high above the square, and the children ran after it.
ex.cn: 一只风筝高高飞在广场上空，孩子们追着它跑。
ex.note: fly a kite 放风筝

ex.en: Lately he has been reading more novels than textbooks.
ex.cn: 最近他读小说比读教科书还多。
ex.note: lately = recently 最近；have lately been doing 最近一直在做

ex.en: She gave a short lecture on how to write a good proposal.
ex.cn: 她做了一场关于如何写好一份提案的简短讲座。
ex.note: give a lecture 作讲座；a lecture on 关于…的训斥

ex.en: The teacher lectured us for twenty minutes about neat handwriting.
ex.cn: 老师就书写工整这件事训了我们二十分钟。
ex.note: lecture sb. on sth. 就某事训斥某人

ex.en: It is likely that most students will sell their old books before the new term.
ex.cn: 很可能大多数学生会在新学期前把旧书卖掉。
ex.note: be likely to do 很可能做；It is likely that … 有可能…

ex.en: If you leave now, you will likely miss the last bus.
ex.cn: 如果你现在就走，很可能会错过末班车。
ex.note: likely to happen 很可能发生

ex.en: We lodged at a small hotel near the station for two nights.
ex.cn: 我们在车站附近一家小旅馆住了两晚。
ex.note: lodge at/in 寄宿于；lodge a complaint 提出投诉

ex.en: The old gate lodge had stood empty for years before it was repaired.
ex.cn: 那座旧门房小屋空了多年，才终于被修好。
ex.note: a shooting lodge 狩猎小屋；the porter's lodge 门房小屋

ex.en: Most of the work is now done by machine, which saves hours every day.
ex.cn: 大部分工作现在都由机器完成，每天能省下好几个小时。
ex.note: a washing machine 洗衣机；machine translation 机器翻译

ex.en: Many students signed up on the first day, but few of them came back.
ex.cn: 第一天有很多学生注册，可真正回头的却很少。
ex.note: many a 许多（谓语用单数）；as many as 多达；a great many 许多

ex.en: A bicycle is a cheap means of transport for students living on campus.
ex.cn: 对住校的学生来说，自行车是一种廉价的交通工具。
ex.note: by means of 借助于；by no means 决不；the means of production 生产资料

ex.en: The message on the wall said that all the notices were out of date.
ex.cn: 墙上的告示说，所有通知都已过期。
ex.note: take a message 捎口信；the message of a story 作品的主旨

ex.en: He missed the last bus and had to walk home in the cold.
ex.cn: 他错过了末班车，只好在寒风里走回家。
ex.note: miss the point 没抓住重点；miss sb. 想念某人

ex.en: "Yes, miss, the shop is closed for lunch."
ex.cn: “好的，小姐，商店午餐时间关门。”
ex.note: Yes, miss 好的，小姐（对女招待或教师的称呼）

ex.en: He set out early in the morning and reached the campus before noon.
ex.cn: 他一大早出发，中午之前就到了学校。
ex.note: in the morning 在早上；the following morning 第二天早上

ex.en: The agreement was based on mutual trust, and both sides kept their word.
ex.cn: 这份协议建立在相互信任的基础上，双方都信守了承诺。
ex.note: mutual trust 相互信任；mutual respect 相互尊重；mutual benefit 互利

ex.en: The tailor threaded a needle and began to mend the old coat.
ex.cn: 裁缝把线穿过针孔，开始缝补那件旧外套。
ex.note: a needle in a haystack 大海捞针；needle and thread 针线

ex.en: He wanted to do something noble, not merely profitable.
ex.cn: 他想做点高尚的事，而不只是为了赚钱。
ex.note: a noble purpose 高尚的目的；a noble gas 惰性气体

ex.en: The number of books in the shop dropped sharply after the sale.
ex.cn: 促销之后，店里的书数量骤降。
ex.note: a number of 许多（可数）；the number of … …的数量

ex.en: Each book on the shelf is numbered, so that it can be found again.
ex.cn: 书架上的每本书都有编号，以便日后能再找到它。
ex.note: number the pages 给页码编号；number among … 列入…之中

ex.en: One careless remark at the meeting offended several parents.
ex.cn: 会上的一句不慎的话得罪了好几位家长。
ex.note: offend sb. 冒犯某人；be offended at 为…感到不快

ex.en: The two statements have opposite meanings, though the words look the same.
ex.cn: 这两句话的意思恰好相反，尽管用词看起来一样。
ex.note: the opposite side 对面；the opposite of … …的反面

ex.en: His opposite on the committee argued that the plan was too risky.
ex.cn: 他在委员会里的对头认为这个方案风险太大。
ex.note: the opposite of … …的对立面；quite the opposite 恰恰相反

ex.en: They set up a table in the square opposite the main library.
ex.cn: 他们在主图书馆对面的广场上支起一张桌子。
ex.note: opposite to 面对；opposite sb. 在某人对面

ex.en: He showed me the outline of the project on a single page.
ex.cn: 他把那份项目的提纲给我看，只有一页纸。
ex.note: an outline of … …的提纲；a brief outline 简要提纲

ex.en: She outlined the main difficulties in three sentences.
ex.cn: 她用三句话概述了主要困难。
ex.note: outline a plan 概述计划；outline sth. briefly 简要概述某事

ex.en: It was a painful decision to shut the project down, but they made it.
ex.cn: 关掉这个项目是个痛苦的决定，但他们还是做了。
ex.note: a painful decision 艰难的决定；painfully 痛苦地

ex.en: They held a small party in a restaurant after the final.
ex.cn: 决赛之后，他们在一家餐馆办了个小聚会。
ex.note: a political party 政党；the winning party 胜诉方；throw a party 举办聚会

ex.en: She wrote the date in the corner of the page with a blue pen.
ex.cn: 她用蓝色钢笔把日期写在页角上。
ex.note: a pen friend 笔友；pen and ink 钢笔和墨水

ex.en: Petrol prices rose again last month, so many people drive less now.
ex.cn: 上个月汽油又涨价了，于是很多人现在开得少了。
ex.note: petrol station 加油站；a petrol engine 汽油发动机

ex.en: She is a pioneer in the study of old Chinese books.
ex.cn: 她是古代中国书籍研究领域的开拓者。
ex.note: a pioneer of … …的先驱；a pioneer in … …领域的先驱

ex.en: The company pioneered a new way of selling second-hand goods.
ex.cn: 这家公司开创了二手商品销售的新方式。
ex.note: pioneer sth. 开创某事

ex.en: There is one point in the plan that he would not change.
ex.cn: 这个方案里有一处是他不肯改的。
ex.note: a key point 关键点；make a point 表明观点；at this point 此刻

ex.en: She pointed at the three books on the screen without saying a word.
ex.cn: 她指着屏幕上的那三本书，一句话也没说。
ex.note: point at/to 指向；point out 指出

ex.en: He took up a position in the student affairs bureau and stayed for two years.
ex.cn: 他在学生事务处谋了个职位，一干就是两年。
ex.note: take up a position 担任职位；a difficult position 艰难的处境

ex.en: Nobody could predict that the little site would grow so fast.
ex.cn: 没有人能料到这个小网站会壮大得这么快。
ex.note: predict the future 预测未来；It is predicted that … 据预测…

ex.en: She never breaks the principle of being honest with her users.
ex.cn: 她从不违背对用户坦诚这个原则。
ex.note: in principle 原则上；a guiding principle 指导原则；on principle 根据原则

ex.en: The poster was made to promote the launch of the website.
ex.cn: 那张海报是为了给网站上线造势而做的。
ex.note: promote growth 促进增长；promote sb. to 提升某人至…；promote a product 推销产品

ex.en: She pulled the door shut behind her and turned the key.
ex.cn: 她随手带上门，拧动了钥匙。
ex.note: pull up 停下；pull over 靠边停车；a strong pull 强大的吸引力

ex.en: He had a short quiz in the morning and arrived late for the meeting.
ex.cn: 他上午有一场小测验，赶到会场时迟到了。
ex.note: a quiz 小测验；a quiz show 知识竞赛节目

ex.en: His reaction to the news was calm; he simply asked for more details.
ex.cn: 他对这消息的反应很平静，只是问了更多细节。
ex.note: in reaction to 对…的反应；a chemical reaction 化学反应

ex.en: For most students in the library, the square is the only place for recreation.
ex.cn: 对大多数待在图书馆里的学生来说，广场是唯一的消遣之所。
ex.note: outdoor recreation 户外娱乐；a recreation ground 游乐场

ex.en: The relationship between the two classes was never easy, but it improved slowly.
ex.cn: 这两个班之间的关系从不容易，但慢慢好起来了。
ex.note: a close relationship 密切关系；have a relationship with 与…有关系

ex.en: A reporter from the campus newspaper came to cover the event.
ex.cn: 校报的一名记者来采访这件事。
ex.note: a newspaper reporter 新闻记者；a court reporter 法庭记录员

ex.en: They had dinner at a small restaurant near the north gate.
ex.cn: 他们在北门附近一家小餐馆吃了晚饭。
ex.note: a fast-food restaurant 快餐厅；take someone out to a restaurant 请某人下馆子

ex.en: The time may not be ripe for a full-scale launch yet.
ex.cn: 全面上线的时机可能还没成熟。
ex.note: ripe for 成熟可摘；be ripe for the market 上市的时机成熟

ex.en: She tied the bundle of posters with two rubber bands.
ex.cn: 她用两根橡皮筋把那捆海报扎起来。
ex.note: rubber band 橡皮筋；natural rubber 天然橡胶

ex.en: They handed out cheese sandwiches and hot coffee to anyone who stopped.
ex.cn: 他们给每一个停下来的人分发奶酪三明治和热咖啡。
ex.note: a ham sandwich 火腿三明治；make a sandwich 做三明治

ex.en: She explained the method in plain, scientific language.
ex.cn: 她用简明的科学语言解释了这个方法。
ex.note: the scientific method 科学方法；scientific evidence 科学证据

ex.en: He seized the chance to present the plan and won second prize.
ex.cn: 他抓住机会展示方案，最后赢得了二等奖。
ex.note: seize the chance/opportunity 抓住机会；seize control 夺取控制权

ex.en: About seventy people turned up for the open day.
ex.cn: 大约有七十人来参加了开放日。
ex.note: seventy-odd 七十多；in the seventies 七十年代

ex.en: Online shopping has changed the way small shops do business.
ex.cn: 网上购物改变了小店的经营方式。
ex.note: go shopping 去购物；a shopping centre 购物中心；a shopping list 购物清单

ex.en: The old bowl at the bottom of the chest was made of solid silver.
ex.cn: 柜子底下那只旧碗是纯银的。
ex.note: silver screen 银幕；a silver wedding 银婚

ex.en: A silver laptop lay open on the desk, its fan humming.
ex.cn: 书桌上摊着一台银色笔记本电脑，风扇嗡嗡转着。
ex.note: silver hair 银发；silver lining 一线希望

ex.en: The winter sky was clear, and the moon shone on the snow.
ex.cn: 冬日的天空很澄澈，月光洒在雪地上。
ex.note: the open sky 露天；in the sky 在天空中

ex.en: Social media can help a small shop reach customers it could never meet before.
ex.cn: 社交媒体能帮助小店接触到以前根本遇不到的客户。
ex.note: social life 社交生活；social network 社交网络；social science 社会科学

ex.en: "I am sorry, but the shop has already closed for the day."
ex.cn: “抱歉，今天的店已经关门了。”
ex.note: be sorry about sth. 对某事感到抱歉；a sorry state 可怜的境地

ex.en: Can you spell this word for me? I want to write it on the label.
ex.cn: 这个词你能拼一下吗？我想在标签上写出来。
ex.note: spell out 详细说明；spell sth. for sb. 拼给某人；= mean 意味着

ex.en: There was a spell of fine weather in the middle of the rainy season.
ex.cn: 雨季中间有过一段好天气。
ex.note: a spell of rain/fine weather 一阵雨/一段好天气；for a spell 暂时

ex.en: There was a dark stain on the wall where the picture had hung.
ex.cn: 墙上有一块深色的污渍，是原来挂画的地方。
ex.note: a stain on … …上的污渍；remove a stain 除去污渍

ex.en: Be careful not to stain the table with that ink.
ex.cn: 小心别把墨水弄到桌子上。
ex.note: be stained with 被…染污；stain sb.'s reputation 玷污某人的名声

ex.en: After three hours in the cold, his fingers felt stiff.
ex.cn: 在冷风里待了三个钟头后，他的手指冻得发僵。
ex.note: a stiff neck 脖子发僵；stiff competition 激烈的竞争；a stiff breeze 猛烈的风

ex.en: The road stretches along the river for several miles.
ex.cn: 这条沿着河的路延伸了了好几英里。
ex.note: stretch out 伸展四肢；stretch one's legs 活动腿脚

ex.en: He worked for a stretch of two hours without a break.
ex.cn: 他一口气干了两个小时，中间没有休息。
ex.note: a long stretch of time 一长段时间；at a stretch 一口气

ex.en: A sudden shower caught them in the open square.
ex.cn: 一场突如其来的阵雨把他们困在了露天广场上。
ex.note: all of a sudden 突然；a sudden change 突然的变化

ex.en: A supporter of the plan gave them a hand in the end.
ex.cn: 最后，一位支持这个方案的人帮了他们一把。
ex.note: a supporter of … …的支持者；a strong supporter 坚定的支持者

ex.en: The red bird is a symbol of courage in that culture.
ex.cn: 在那套文化里，红鸟是勇气的象征。
ex.note: a symbol of … …的象征；a chemical symbol 化学符号

ex.en: The report was written in plain language, without a single technical term.
ex.cn: 这份报告是用大白话写的，没有一个专业术语。
ex.note: technical terms 专业术语；technical difficulty 技术难题

ex.en: He spent ten minutes writing the text of the announcement.
ex.cn: 他花了十分钟写公告的正文。
ex.note: a text message 短信；a textbook 教科书

ex.en: He texted the group chat with the time of the meeting.
ex.cn: 他在群里发了条短信，通知开会时间。
ex.note: text sb. 给某人发短信

ex.en: After the long walk, his thirst was stronger than his hunger.
ex.cn: 走了长路之后，他觉得渴比饿更难熬。
ex.note: quench one's thirst 解渴；a thirst for knowledge 对知识的渴望

ex.en: He kept the rope tight around the bundle of posters.
ex.cn: 他在那捆海报上把绳子绑得很紧。
ex.note: a tight budget 紧张的开销；tight security 严密的安保；in tight condition 状况良好的

ex.en: Hold the rope tight and pull it slowly.
ex.cn: 把绳子拉紧，慢慢地拉。
ex.note: hold tight 抓紧；tight shut 紧紧关上

ex.en: The dentist told him to brush his teeth twice a day.
ex.cn: 牙医让他每天刷两次牙。
ex.note: brush one's teeth 刷牙；a toothache 牙痛

ex.en: The glass door of the shop is completely transparent.
ex.cn: 商店的玻璃门完全透明。
ex.note: transparent to 对…透明；transparent about 坦率地；be transparent 公开透明

ex.en: He picked up his trumpet and played a few notes to the children.
ex.cn: 他拿起小号，给孩子们吹了几个音。
ex.note: play the trumpet 吹小号；a trumpet call 号角声

ex.en: Every undergraduate has to take at least one course in a foreign language.
ex.cn: 每个本科生至少要修一门外语课。
ex.note: an undergraduate degree 本科学位；postgraduate 研究生

ex.en: He placed the ladder upright against the wall.
ex.cn: 他把梯子直直地靠在墙边。
ex.note: upright and honest 正直诚实；keep sth. upright 使某物保持直立

ex.en: The students sat upright in their chairs and listened carefully.
ex.cn: 学生们端端正正地坐在椅子上，认真听着。
ex.note: stand upright 笔直站着；sit upright 坐直

ex.en: Prices here are highly variable and can change from week to week.
ex.cn: 这里的价格变动很大，可能一周一个样。
ex.note: variable costs 可变成本；highly variable 变化很大的

ex.en: The more variables you add, the harder the model becomes to explain.
ex.cn: 你加进去的变量越多，这个模型就越难解释。
ex.note: a dependent variable 因变量；an independent variable 自变量

ex.en: The lectures will be given in virtual classrooms this term.
ex.cn: 本学期的讲座将在虚拟教室里上。
ex.note: virtual reality 虚拟现实；virtually 几乎；virtually speaking 实际上

ex.en: They cleaned the old wall and painted a fresh coat of white on it.
ex.cn: 他们把旧墙清理干净，刷上了一层新白漆。
ex.note: a brick wall 砖墙；against the wall 碰壁；the wall of a room 房间的墙壁

ex.en: The garden was full of weeds after a month of rain.
ex.cn: 下了一个月的雨后，花园里长满了杂草。
ex.note: pull out the weeds 拔掉杂草；weed killer 除草剂

ex.en: They weeded the vegetable beds every Saturday morning.
ex.cn: 他们每个星期六上午给菜畦除草。
ex.note: weed the garden 给花园除草；weed out 剔除

ex.en: She leaned close and whispered the answer in his ear.
ex.cn: 她凑近了些，把答案在他耳边低声说了出来。
ex.note: whisper to sb. 对某人低语；a whisper 一阵低语；whispered voices 低语声

ex.en: His short speech was full of wit, and the audience laughed.
ex.cn: 他那番简短的话机智百出，听众都笑了。
ex.note: a man of wit 说话风趣的人；wit and wisdom 妙语连珠

ex.en: The old wound in his leg still ached in cold weather.
ex.cn: 腿上那道旧伤每到冷天还会隐隐作痛。
ex.note: a wound in the flesh 肉体上的伤口；a deep wound 深深的创伤

ex.en: The sharp edge of the tin wounded his hand.
ex.cn: 铁罐的锋利边缘划伤了他的手。
ex.note: be wounded in battle 在战斗中负伤
